I don't have time to review all of them rn but I like what you did here. just change one thing through out the app and implement the rest.
stop saying "Quiet tally" or "Quiet ledger" and etc. stop using the word quiet. Cuz the persian translation of it is very weird and alien. آرام sounds weird, let's make it personal and the persian would be شخصی and that's a better one. let's get to work
authorization.scope: Implement the Pashto drafts and replace the quiet brand wording with personal / شخصی / شخصي. Existing English/Dari catalog wording is retained except the named brand and automatic-backup wording. Supplemental recovery clarification and missing-language counterparts are itemized per ID.
authorization.review_meaning: User authorized implementation; approvals do not claim individual native-speaker proofreading of every entry.

snapshot.note: Original manifest and source-snapshot describe the historical extraction; application_changed:false and unapproved wording there refer only to that snapshot.

validation.runtime: Complete TypeScript catalog keys and text in en/fa/ps; semantic source selectors for supplemental tables/resources; source fragments for composed Go/HTML messages. Text fingerprints exclude unrelated code changes.
validation.historical: Original IDs, current text, source locations, placeholder metadata, references and context remain immutable against review-baseline.json.
validation.linguistic_limit: Structural validation cannot certify idiom, legal meaning, runtime visual layout or Go placeholder argument order.

verified.backend: Go build and locale/mail/shared suites; selected invitation/notification tests; real isolated PostgreSQL persistence, outreach and migration tests passed. Test cluster removed; development DB untouched.
verified.mobile: Mobile TypeScript and all 86 mobile selftest suites passed (86 passed, 0 failed). The native trust-fixture CRLF/LF portability failure is fixed: line endings are normalized with strict content and mutation checks retained. All 292 vectors and 7 wrapper tests passed. Language, Pashto, notifications and Ninja-mode behavior checks passed.
verified.fonts: Bundled Vazirmatn 400/500/600/700 character maps cover all 51 Arabic-script characters in the Pashto drafts.
verified.ninja_mode: The original NinjaIcon is restored. EN/FA/PS auth tests cover the Ninja-mode CTA, warning, wrapping, RTL, order, busy state and redirect behavior.
verified.android_device_build: Android 2.2.2/code65 arm64 device diagnostic built from d75194ba37287b86b2119622b89637bce72b1381 plus android.versionCode 64->65. All 37 AAB and 29 APK static checks passed, including all 4479 catalog strings, fresh en/fa/ps native resources, exact Ninja copy/icon and the original installed Play signer. Google code65 is an independently verified internal draft only; previous releases, other tracks, app details, listing text and images are preserved. AAB SHA256 232069b4c9fbf838599b7ffed6393920d3e20b69b8a574a9feb14029e11e40ac; APK SHA256 5212ff582d0b192ee301cfc5f05428123405ff827831fd3272045f3a54259c92. Receipts are in ignored build/pashto-ninja-device/; docs/kaata-2-testing.md records scope. Installation and launch await the Xiaomi Play Protect check and approval.

deferred: Android code65 installation and launch await the Xiaomi Play Protect check and approval. Full Pashto/Ninja visual review, native phone layout, line wrapping, actual OS permissions and notification delivery still need device verification; a new iOS build is pending.
No browser visual smoke test was possible because no browser surface was enabled.
Legal/admin prose outside the extracted outreach defaults remains a separate editorial/localization audit.
Live announcements, operator template overrides, store listings/artwork and Google/Apple/OS-owned screens were not changed.

Pushing main triggers backend/web deployment through Dokploy; deployment outcome and production migration 065 are not verified here. Android code65 is device-only and not distributed; the next store upload must use code66 or higher. A new iOS build is still required.

approved_text.ps: یو چا، ښايي تاسو، د دې پتې لپاره د کاټه کوډ غوښتی دی. ستاسو د کاټه حساب د ګوګل یا اپل له لارې پرانیستل کېږي، خو د پټنوم له لارې د ننوتلو لپاره مو بله برېښنالیک پته، {address}، کارولې ده. د پټنوم د بیا ټاکلو کوډونه هغې پتې ته لېږل کېږي. که هغه پته نه پېژنئ، د ګوګل یا اپل له لارې ننوځئ، «حساب» او بیا «ننوتل» پرانیزئ او پټنوم لرې کړئ. که نه، دا برېښنالیک له پامه غورځولای شئ.

effective.en: Someone, maybe you, asked for a Kaata code for this address. Your Kaata account signs in with Google or Apple, and its password belongs to another email address, {address}, where reset codes go. If you don't recognize that address, sign in with Google or Apple, open Account, then Sign-in, and remove the password. Otherwise you can ignore this email.
effective.fa: کسی، شاید خود شما، برای این آدرس کود کاتا خواست. با گوگل یا اپل وارد حساب کاتای خود می‌شوید، اما برای ورود با رمز از آدرس ایمیل دیگری، {address}، استفاده می‌کنید. کودهای بازیابی رمز به آن آدرس فرستاده می‌شوند. اگر آن آدرس را نمی‌شناسید، با گوگل یا اپل وارد شوید، «حساب» و سپس «ورود» را باز کنید و رمز را حذف کنید. در غیر آن، می‌توانید این ایمیل را نادیده بگیرید.
